comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: The section about Brazil's favelas really made me think about how easily outsiders can reduce entire communities to a single stereotype. Beyond the challenges that receive so much attention, what are the everyday strengths of these neighborhoods? I'd love to hear from residents about local businesses, friendships, and community traditions that documentaries often overlook.
